title: Dataverse Dataset
description: A research dataset as represented by the University of Chile Dataverse API (datos.uchile.cl). Properties reflect the Dataset schema published in the deployment's live OpenAPI document (Dataverse 5.13).

id.description: Internal numeric identifier of the dataset.

identifierRegistered.description: Whether the global ID has been registered with the provider (DataCite).

globalIdCreateTime.description: When the global ID was created.

createDate.description: Date the dataset record was created.

fileAccessRequest.description: Whether file access requests are enabled.

useGenericThumbnail.description: Whether a generic thumbnail is used.

previewImageAvailable.description: Whether a preview image is available.

harvestIdentifier.description: Identifier if the dataset was harvested.

harvestedFrom.description: Harvesting client the dataset was harvested from.
